policy: Every 3D asset must be declared here before use. Generated images are original project assets based on user-provided visual direction only; reference images are not copied or stored.

assets.name: Generated Kurukshetra unit reference image set
assets.author: MIRROR project using built-in image generation
assets.modifications: chroma-key background removal, crop, trim, board texture placement, and archived visual reference. Playable units are now procedural Three.js meshes rather than sprite/image-card pieces.
assets.notes: Created from text prompts derived from the user's uploaded visual references. The references guided style, materials, camera, and unit identity only; no reference image is copied or stored in the repository. These PNGs are not used for the current playable unit bodies.

assets.name: Playable volumetric Kurukshetra mesh army
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.notes: Actual runtime playable units: mesh soldiers, horse archers, advisor/standard bearers, chariots, war elephants, royal commanders, weapons, contact shadows, attacker lunge, and non-gory capture impact/fall/dust.
